overall_arc: Marcus begins cautiously optimistic, spikes in satisfaction when the onboarding respects his time and technical fluency, experiences a brief dip at premature KYC gates, then recovers to strong advocacy once the deferred verification flow proves seamless and the core product delivers real value.
moment_of_truth: The appearance of the 'skip optional steps' prompt during the onboarding questionnaire — if this option is absent or buried, Marcus immediately categorises the app as low-quality and disengages; if it is prominent and functional, it earns his trust for the rest of the journey.
biggest_pain_point: Being shown a KYC document upload requirement before experiencing any product value, with no clear indication of which features remain accessible if he defers — creating a perceived cost-before-benefit barrier that risks immediate drop-off.
